scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w server
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared -w client -w server
